paragraphs: When the duo La Leona and Chris.Me take over the decks, standing still is simply not an option. Their sets combine bouncy Tech House and driving Indie Dance with melodic surprises that hit straight to the heart and move your feet. They are all about that infectious energy, remixes of beloved classics, and creating that unmistakable "bass-face" feeling.

Their love for music, dancing, and their community drives them to create these moments and contribute to the shared energy on the dancefloor. As part of the Escon collective and the Why Not family, their music and radiant positive vibe bring happiness to the crowd. They create a space where collective dancefloor magic happens, taking the energy constantly forward and upward.
For these two party animals, one thing matters most: that everyone - both on the dancefloor and behind the decks - loses themselves with a smile.
